faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers to the most important questions about your visit.

q1.question: Where can I find toilets in the park?
q1.answer: Public restrooms are signposted at the main entrances. Use our Location Finder to find the nearest toilet. Some are pay toilets (approx. ¬0.50), others are free.

q2.question: Is the park accessible?
q2.answer: The paved main paths are well accessible for wheelchairs and strollers. Some natural paths have inclines and are less suitable. The Flatow Tower is not accessible (only reachable via stairs).

q3.question: Am I allowed to barbecue or picnic in the park?
q3.answer: Picnicking is allowed on the lawns. Barbecuing is prohibited throughout the park (fire protection). Please take your trash with you or dispose of it in the provided bins.

q4.question: Can I cycle through the park?
q4.answer: Cycling is only allowed on the paved main paths. Cycling is prohibited on hiking trails and natural paths. Pay attention to on-site signs. More details in our Park Rules.

q5.question: Are dogs allowed in the park?
q5.answer: Yes, dogs are allowed but must be kept on a leash. Please bring dog waste bags and dispose of them in the trash bins.

q6.question: Can I swim in the Havel?
q6.answer: No, swimming in the Havel is prohibited (no lifeguards, currents, boat traffic). Alternative swimming areas are available at Heiliger See lake in Neuer Garten.

q7.question: Are there guided tours through the park?
q7.answer: Yes, the Prussian Palaces and Gardens Foundation offers regular tours. Dates and booking at www.spsg.de.

q8.question: How much time should I plan for a visit?
q8.answer: For a relaxed walk: 2-3 hours. With palace visit and Flatow Tower: 4-5 hours. For all 4 areas: full-day trip recommended.
